asked.item: add assistant as a second user with her own login

verdict.reason: The help pages state that separate teammate logins are not available and that Blotato has no passwords, and they describe the only sharing method.

steps.text: Blotato supports one user per account, and separate teammate logins are not live yet.
Blotato does not use passwords, so there is no password to set for your assistant.
Today, you share access by giving your assistant your login email and the authentication code sent to your email; whoever has the code signs in as you, with no separate roles or audit trail.
Have your assistant enter your email address when logging in, give her the authentication code sent to your email, and she completes the login process.
